issues.title: ESE Prelims 2021 · Q43
issues.issue: The question does not define its historical relative ozone-destruction scale. Standard ODP for R12 is1.0, absent from the options. An official key or defined alternative scale is needed before automatic scoring. Reference: https://www.epa.gov/ozone-layer-protection/ozone-depleting-substances

issues.title: ESE Prelims 2017 · Q46
issues.issue: Only statement2 is unconditionally correct. The medium being cooled must be warmer than the evaporator. Solar storage or backup can permit continuous operation. The book accepts2and3(C), which assumes an unstated solar configuration; no option contains only2. Excluded from automatic scoring.

issues.title: ESE Prelims 2022 · Q108
issues.issue: The question asks for length, but printed options have viscosity-like units kg·s⁻¹·m⁻¹. Refrigerant property/viscosity data for sectionwise integration are also absent. Use adiabatic flash enthalpy and momentum with friction/acceleration across48,40,30,20,10,5°C. No numerical option is safely verified from these data alone.
